title: PrintParams
description: Editor parameters shared verbatim by the live preview and the bake pipeline. Ranges from 01_PRODUCT_SPEC.md's editor parameter table (percent ranges expressed as fractions), defaults from 02_TECH_SPEC.md's example.

base_thickness_mm.description: Solid slab thickness under everything, mm.

nozzle_mm.description: Nozzle diameter, mm. Drives the minimum-feature thresholds in 04.

small_scale.description: Height multiplier for buildings under 40 m (is_tall == false).

large_scale.description: Height multiplier for buildings 40 m and over (is_tall == true).

terrain_exaggeration.description: Ignored while terrain is disabled (out of scope for the MVP).

road_scale.description: Width multiplier applied before the minimum-feature clamp in 04.
